note: Every name here carries a decision that was made deliberately. A name that appears in NO version file and no local overlay is refused, never guessed: a silent drop is how the highest-value user turns get lost. Version files UNION rather than supersede -- logs are historical, and a corpus written last quarter still contains the types that existed then.

recordTypes.drop-after-use: read for working directory tracking at step 4, dropped at step 7; the ordering is load-bearing

contentBlocks.drop-counted: replaced by a placeholder that records it existed

rationale.recordTypes.custom-title: Written by the HUMAN, so it is the one of the three late additions that can carry a client name or a person. ai-title is already dropped for the machine-written equivalent; a hand-typed title is strictly more identifying, not less. 12,319 records over 261 depth-0 sessions.
rationale.recordTypes.history-suppression: {sessionId, cause, ts} where cause is a token such as fork_inherit. No user text. 412 records.
rationale.recordTypes.cost-state: Per-session bookkeeping: totalCostUSD, tool durations, totalLinesAdded/Removed, a modelUsage map, and startTime as a raw millisecond epoch. The line counts are tempting -- the same measurement reconstructed from structuredPatch -- but startTime alone would reinstate to the millisecond exactly what quantise() spent the timestamp budget removing. Dropped whole rather than filtered; admitting the counts is a separate decision with its own review. 6 records.
rationale.recordTypes.bridge-session: Holds an account uuid, the identifier no detector matches.
rationale.attachmentTypes.directory: A listing: a path plus the FILE NAMES under it, which is client and project vocabulary in its most concentrated form.
rationale.attachmentTypes.pdf_reference: An absolute path plus a displayPath. The one measured here named a client solicitation document in the filename alone.
rationale.attachmentTypes.already_read_file: An absolute path plus a displayPath.
rationale.attachmentTypes.hook_non_blocking_error: Up to a kilobyte of raw stderr plus the command line that produced it.
rationale.attachmentTypes.task_status: A model-written description and deltaSummary of the work -- prose, but not the user's.
rationale.attachmentTypes.workflow_keyword_request: A bare marker with no payload; dropped for consistency, not for risk.
rationale.attachmentTypes.ultra_effort_exit: A bare marker with no payload; dropped for consistency, not for risk.
rationale.systemSubtypes.away_summary: Prose naming third parties who never consented; dropped even though it is user-adjacent.
